name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for Harwness
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What is missing or awkward today?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like. If it affects the tool surface,
approvals, configuration, or the CLI/TUI, describe the shape of the change
(new tool name, new command, new config key, ...).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you considered, and why you prefer this one.

## Security and trust boundary impact

If the feature adds a new tool, a new source of untrusted input, or touches
approvals, sandboxing, or privilege — say so here. See
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the invariants a new feature must not
weaken (for example: destructive or privileged operations should default to
requiring approval, and privileges should only shrink toward child agents).

## Additional context

Mockups, example CLI sessions, related issues or discussions.
